## Controls

| ID | Control | Category | Tier | Status | Applies To | Requirements | Mitigates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `control:plugin-signature-verification` | **Verify plugin publisher signature before install**<br>The IDE refuses to install a Code Assistant Plugin unless it is signed by the expected publisher key. | preventive | - | recommended | Integrated Development Environment (IDE)<br>Code Assistant Plugin<br>Plugin Marketplace delivers plugin to IDE | NIST SP 800-53: CM-14 Signed Components, SI-7(15) Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity \| Code Authentication | `threat:malicious-marketplace-plugin` |
| `control:plugin-allowlist` | **Allow-list approved plugin marketplaces and publishers**<br>Only plugins from approved marketplaces and publisher IDs can be installed, enforced by IDE policy. | preventive | - | recommended | Integrated Development Environment (IDE)<br>External Plugin Marketplace | NIST SP 800-53: CM-11 User-installed Software, SR-4 Provenance<br>CSA AI Controls Matrix: STA-08 Supply Chain Inventory | `threat:malicious-marketplace-plugin` |
| `control:plugin-sandboxing` | **Run AI plugins with restricted file and network access**<br>The plugin runs in a sandbox that limits which files it can read and which hosts it can reach, and its egress is monitored. | detective | - | recommended | Code Assistant Plugin | NIST SP 800-53: SC-7 Boundary Protection, SI-4 System Monitoring<br>CSA AI Controls Matrix: AIS-13 AI Sandboxing | `threat:malicious-marketplace-plugin` |
